messages:
Maya Chen: Quick check — after last night's canary (us-east-dedicated), I noticed a jump in KV cache evictions and wider SM% variance across GPUs. Where can I find:
- per-instance SM% heatmap
- KV cache eviction rate/time-series
- batch size distribution panel

Need to know whether to tune alerts or rollback. cc @Ryan Patel @Danielle Kim

Ryan Patel: Dashboards: 
- SM heatmap: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/8f7e9a/sm-heatmap?orgId=1&var-env=prod
- KV evictions: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/2b4c1e/kvcache-evictions?orgId=1&var-cluster=us-east
- Batching distro: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/5d1f3b/batch-stats

Try PromQL snippets:
```
avg by (instance) (gpu_sm_utilization{env="prod"})
rate(kvcache_evictions_total{cluster="us-east"}[5m])
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

Danielle Kim: If evictions spike, we should raise kvcache size or fallback to longer prefix cache TTL. For alerts, start with: `kvcache_evictions_rate > 5` per instance sustained for 5m.

Josh Ortega: Also watch GPU memory% and OOM churn. Suggest alert rules: 
- `gpu_memory_used_ratio > 0.86` (avg by instance) for 3m
- `kvcache_evictions_rate > 5` for 3m

Maya Chen: Ping infra runbook? where's the playbook for these alerts + runbook for canary rollback?

Ryan Patel: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/GPU+Ops+runbook (see section "KV cache regressions").
I'll open an alert PR to reduce noisy alerts and link the dashboards. Assigning the PR to @Danielle Kim.

infra-bot: Created issue RED-3245: "Investigate KV evictions spike after canary" assigned to Danielle Kim — https://issues.redwood.ai/RED-3245

Danielle Kim: Got it — I'll triage first thing. Plan: check canary config, review quantization/packing changes, and confirm batch size distribution. If confirmed, increase cache size and mute alert for 1 hour. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Thanks — if you need me to run any traces or share specific pod logs say so. Quick command to get per-pod GPU SM% traces:
```
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=gpu-exporter --since=2h | jq '.metrics | select(.name=="gpu_sm_utilization")'
```

Ryan Patel: Adding dashboards to the eng-runtime pinned list. :white_check_mark:

Maya Chen: If we end up tuning alerts, let's land an explicit owner and mute window in the PR so ops doesn't get paged repeatedly.

Josh Ortega: Agree. Also might be worth a short canary re-run with `batch_size=64` vs `batch_size=32` to see impact on SM% and evictions.

Maya Chen: Good call — I'll schedule a quick canary re-run this afternoon and post results here.

End.
